_note: The 'Our Story' section on /about — a scroll-pinned stack of frosted-glass chapter cards. Sticky heading on the left, chapters pile on top of one another as the reader scrolls.
label: WHO WE ARE
intro: From a bold idea in Pakistan to enterprise-grade products shipping worldwide — here's how Barakode became the partner teams trust to build, scale, and support what matters most.

chapters.title: Born in Pakistan, Built for the World
chapters.description: Barakode began in 2025 with a single conviction: world-class software shouldn't be bound by geography. We set out to engineer enterprise-grade products that hold their own on any stage — shipped from Pakistan, built for the world.

chapters.title: A Full-Cycle Mission
chapters.description: We exist to turn ambitious ideas into reliable, scalable products. From a startup's first users to an enterprise modernizing at scale, we engineer the digital foundations that businesses are built to grow on.

chapters.title: Precision as a Default
chapters.description: Clean architecture, rigorous testing, and an obsession with the details are non-negotiable. We build it right the first time — because software engineered with precision is software that lasts.

chapters.title: Trusted Across Borders
chapters.description: From Pakistan to the USA and Saudi Arabia, our work crosses continents. We partner with founders and teams worldwide, delivering full-cycle web, mobile, AI, and cloud solutions end to end.

chapters.title: Engineering What's Next
chapters.description: We're building the agency we always wanted to hire — transparent, relentless, and invested in outcomes. As technology shifts, we stay at the frontier, so the partners who trust us always do too.

styling.card: rounded-2xl, border white/12%, bg white/6%, backdrop-blur-2xl + saturate-150, shadow 0 18px 55px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.8)
styling.warning: The section must NOT have overflow-hidden — a clipped ancestor kills position:sticky and the cards stop stacking.
